title: Shop at Ciutadella's municipal market
description: Fish and shellfish straight off the boat, fruit and vegetables from island smallholders, and an arcade where people come as much to greet each other as to buy. It is the living market of the western city and the cheapest way to understand what is eaten here, and when. Go in the morning and have breakfast on the spot.
imageAlt: The arcades of Ciutadella's municipal market, people resting in the shade
